messages:
elena: Heads up — PR ready for the release branch. Need a backport + changelog sign-off before we cut tonight. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/3245 (runtime batching fix + docs). Can someone take a look?
matt: On it, will review in ~15.
elena: Thanks. Changelog entry below — should go under Unreleased > Performance:
```
- runtime: reduce batching delay under light load (fixes spike in tail latency) (#3245)
```
Also add labels: backport-needed, changelog-ok.
rob: CI shows one failure: perf-test::test_kv_cache_eviction — looks like a flaky seed, I pushed a tiny deterministic tweak to the test and a logging tweak to the patch. Pushing now.
sasha: @rob thanks — if you push the fix can someone re-run the backport flow? Want to cut at 18:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: CI: build 4543 for PR #3245 — 1324 passed, 1 flaky, 1 failed. https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4543
matt: LGTM after the fix, left a small comment about an extra debug log. :thumbsup:
rob: Fixed and force-pushed. Backport command I use: `./scripts/backport.sh -p 3245 -b release/v1.12` — that creates the backport PR and adds the backport-needed label.
sasha: I can take the backport once CI is green on that commit. tagging @ivy to confirm changelog placement.
ivy: Changelog placement looks good to me, approving now.
matt: Approving as well. Quick nits are non-blocking. :shipit:
elena: Great — schedule: cut release at 18:00 UTC. @deploy-bot please open a release candidate once the backport PR merges. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
deploy-bot: Release candidate rc-v1.12 will be created against release/v1.12 once backport PR merges.
